About Trackier
 Trackier is a leading player in performance marketing technology, offering an integrated suite of products that help brands, agencies, ad networks, and affiliates track, attribute, protect, and grow partner-driven revenue.
 Our ecosystem comprises three products:

• Trackier: A performance marketing and affiliate tracking platform that offers attribution, campaign management, fraud prevention, automation, and invoicing solutions for brands, agencies, and networks.

• Apptrove: A Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) platform that enables app marketers to measure installs and in-app events, analyse attribution, leverage SKAN analytics, and protect against ad fraud.

• Affnook: A dedicated affiliate marketing platform built for the iGaming industry, supporting multiple languages, currencies, and regulated markets.

 Founded in 2016 in New Delhi, Trackier Group operates across India, the US, Singapore, and Dubai, with its platforms serving businesses in 20+ countries, including leading brands such as ICICI Bank, Flipkart, OLX, and Dentsu.
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented AI Motion Graphics Designer & Video Editor with 2–3 years of experience in motion graphics, video editing, animation, and AI-powered video production. 
 As part of our design team, you will be responsible for creating engaging visual experiences that simplify complex SaaS product functionalities, communicate product value, and strengthen our brand presence. 
 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual storytelling, UI animations, product demonstrations, and modern video production techniques, along with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve creativity and production efficiency. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. SaaS Product Video & UI Animation 

• Create engaging product demonstration videos showcasing SaaS features, functionalities, and workflows. 

• Convert static UI designs, dashboards, and product interfaces into dynamic motion graphics. 

• Develop product walkthroughs, feature explainers, onboarding videos, and software tutorials. 

• Create animated UI interactions, transitions, micro-interactions, and user journey demonstrations. 

• Simplify complex product functionalities through clear and engaging visual storytelling. 

 2. Motion Graphics & Video Production

• Create high-quality 2D animations, motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects. 

• Produce product launch videos, feature announcement videos, and promotional content. 

• Develop engaging videos for websites, landing pages, social media, presentations, and marketing campaigns. 

• Create logo animations, branded intros, outros, and other visual assets. 

• Handle complete video production, including editing, sound design, transitions, colour correction, and final rendering. 

 3. AI-Powered Video Production 

• Use AI-powered tools to generate videos, images, animations, voiceovers, and creative visual assets. 

• Experiment with AI video generation and animation workflows to improve production quality and efficiency. 

• Integrate AI-generated visuals with traditional motion graphics and professional video editing. 

• Explore emerging AI tools and implement relevant technologies into the creative workflow. 

 4. Brand & Marketing Communication 

• Create videos for multiple SaaS product brands, maintaining their individual brand identities and visual guidelines. 

• Collaborate with product, marketing, content, and design teams to understand creative requirements. 

• Translate scripts, concepts, and creative briefs into compelling video content. 

• Ensure consistency in typography, colours, animation styles, and overall visual communication. 

 5. Collaboration & Delivery 

• Manage multiple video projects while maintaining quality and delivery timelines. 

• Work closely with designers and content teams to develop storyboards and visual concepts. 

• Take ownership of projects from concept development to final video delivery. 

• Maintain organised project files and reusable animation assets.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple creative assignments. 

• 2–3 years of professional experience in motion graphics and video editing. 

• Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro. 

• Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

• Experience with UI animations, screen recordings, product demonstrations, and software explainer videos. 

• Strong understanding of animation principles, timing, transitions, composition, and typography. 

• Knowledge of sound design, colour grading, and video post-production. 

• Understanding of visual storytelling and creative video composition. 

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple creative assignments. 

 AI Tools & Technologies 
 Hands-on experience or working knowledge of AI-powered creative tools such as: 
 ● Google Veo 
 ● Adobe Firefly 
 ● ElevenLabs 
 ● HeyGen 
 ● Other emerging AI video generation and creative production tools. 
 Candidates should demonstrate the ability to use AI tools practically in real-world video production rather than relying only on basic AI-generated outputs. 
 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience working with SaaS, B2B, technology, or product-based companies. 

• Understanding of SaaS dashboards, product interfaces, and software workflows. 

• Basic knowledge of Figma and UI/UX design concepts. 

• Knowledge of 3D animation, compositing, and visual effects. 

• Experience creating product launch videos, feature demonstrations, and educational content. 

• Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them through simple, engaging visuals. 

• Performance-driven culture with accelerated growth opportunities.

• Competitive compensation aligned with skills and contributions.

• 5-day working week with a focus on work-life balance.
